description: Serif editorial magazine: narrow measure, drop cap, single accent color, generous whitespace.

referenceProfile.thesis: Reading rhythm is built from a narrow single measure, generous vertical whitespace, and one restrained accent color reserved for editorial markers.
signatureMoves: Drop cap and red left-border pull quotes mark editorial emphasis without adding new colors.
Related articles use identical hairline-topped cards to signal a repeatable series.
transferPreserve: Keep body text within a narrow centered measure and let whitespace separate groups.
transferAvoid: Do not add colored surfaces, badges, or decorative cards to the reading flow.
